newsitem.title: USA: AMEX, PCX to trade Boston Communications options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX, PCX to trade Boston Communications options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) and the Pacific Exchange (PCX) said they will begin trading options on Boston Communications Group Inc.
The options will open with strike prices of 10, 12-1/2 and 15 and position limits of 7,500 contracts. Initial expirations have been set for September, October, December and March.
At the AMEX, the specialist will be Kalb, Voorhis/Cranmer & Cranmer. At the PCX, the options have been allocated to lead market makers Paul Mandell and Megan Trainer of Susquehanna.
The options will also trade at the Chicago Board Options Exchange.
